topic: Managing Rollbar access tokens and configurations
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on managing expired Rollbar access tokens necessary for monitoring ML Traffic Impressions. [p1] noted that the token expiration could cause system failures.

It was determined that one specific token is used in `ml_traffic_prediction`, and [p1] can replace it, though uncertainty remains about its usage elsewhere.

[me] suggested regenerating the necessary tokens and updating all relevant configurations and inline code. It was noted that other existing tokens are likely obsolete, as a transfer to http://tower.allunite.com/ occurred previously.
decisions: The specific token used in `ml_traffic_prediction` will be updated by [p1] using a newly generated key.
action_items: [me] needs to regenerate the required Rollbar tokens.
[p1] needs to search GitHub for other potential locations of the old tokens.
